chunk_map.heading: It can only use what someone wrote down

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 6: "Every round moves one more piece of that knowledge" is the closest: 'round' is not named earlier in the file, but it reads as each round of working with the agent, and 'that knowledge' resolves to line 4's 'what you know about your company'. Harm (reader cannot resolve a referent) is absent: no pronoun or demonstrative lacks an antecedent.
No positional or cross-file callback; closest, line 4 'the session and the files it reads', names things, not other files. grep for 'the opening|earlier lecture|last module' in body: none.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw/caught' backward reference

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 4 gives the chunk a self-carrying claim (the agent only has what is written down) and line 6 the consequence; the closest to thin is line 6 alone, but it rides on line 4 in the same chunk.

Header 'It can only use what someone wrote down' vs line 4 'works only from what is in its context: the session and the files it reads ... nobody has written it down'. Closest to contradiction: context includes the session, which someone did not write down; the next clause scopes it to written files, so the header stays literally true for what persists.
No 'Not X. Not Y. Z.', no triples, no superlatives, no numbers, no verb triplets. Closest: line 4 'sits in heads and corridors' is a concrete pair, not an abstraction stack.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: 'context' (line 4) is ordinary engineering vocabulary, not repo dialect; no surface/firing/compendium/beat/mood terms.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep '\*\*' on body: 0 bold elements, within the <=1 budget.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Single `##` slide file included by a standalone include line at curriculum/lectures/compounding.md:54, which the deck treats as transparent; the slide is a top-level chunk, so it is in the composed deck.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers or hand-numbering; check-slide-numbering.js --file: OK

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/only-what-someone-wrote-down.md -> 'OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.'

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no links in body; rule says no verdict beyond review aid

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/only-what-someone-wrote-down.md -> '✓ every slide is within limits' (about 70 words, 0 bullets).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture-hosted slide, heading 'It can only use what someone wrote down' is a claim, as lecture headings should be.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 6 adds a move (each round, knowledge moves from head to files) not stated in line 4; closest to class (a) restatement, but it states the remedy, not the problem again. No design commentary or koan kicker.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no maintainer provenance note of a retitle and no evidence of a header rename without body change
